2610.08513.title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
2610.08513.paper_summary: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences.
2610.08513.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 正在社交環境中越來越多地被部署為自主代理，因此研究它們忠實模擬人類互動的能力變得至關重要。這一核心在於將代理基於現實的用戶角色，然而現有數據集依賴於虛構角色，並且僅限於少數幾種語言，缺乏評估不同人群行為忠實度所需的實證基礎。我們推出了 Wiki-Talkie，這是一個多語言數據集，包含來自五種語言的維基百科討論頁面的現實對話，涵蓋兩個語言家族：日耳曼語系（德語、英語）和羅曼語系（西班牙語、法語、意大利語），並配有來自真實用戶社群的角色，涵蓋社會人口特徵、自我描述和行為基礎的互動特徵。利用 Wiki-Talkie，我們評估代理在各種角色條件策略下的互動行為，進行下一回合生成任務。我們的評估檢視代理是否共同再現人類討論中觀察到的分佈行為模式。結果顯示，用戶的評論歷史在展現互動行為方面始終優於明確的角色信息。此外，模型系統性地低估了負面或極端情緒的產出，而過度產出參考和建議，顯示出對同意性和積極性的偏見。關鍵是，這些模式在不同語言間穩定存在，僅有微小的跨語言差異。
